summary: SaltX Technology Holding AB (publ) engages in the development and sale of sustainable technology in Sweden. It offers electric arc calciner, a technology where fossil-driven heating is replaced with renewable electricity and separate the CO2 emissions released during the heating process. The company's technology is used in quicklime, cement production, energy storage, and carbon dioxide capture, as well as in production of aluminum and magnesium. SaltX Technology Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Hägersten, Sweden.
